name: Oathplate of the First Claim - Kin

evidence.text: Relic: Oathplate of the First Claim - Kin; Availability: Near-Unique; Effect: AC 17, max Dex +1; Kin only; no Speed penalty. Once per short rest, ignore one effect that would shove, knock you prone, or reduce your Speed. Allies within 5 ft gain +1 to saves against forced movement while you are conscious.
